required_parameters.name: searchLocation
required_parameters.description: The value of text field returned in .../auto-complete endpoint

required_parameters.name: searchLocationSubtext
required_parameters.description: The value of subtext field returned in .../auto-complete endpoint

required_parameters.name: type
required_parameters.description: The value of region field returned in .../auto-complete endpoint

optional_parameters.name: keywords
optional_parameters.description: Facilities you are looking for. Separated by comma for multiple options. Ex : pool,garage,etc...

optional_parameters.name: propertyTypes
optional_parameters.description: Ignore or one of the following : townhouse|unit apartment|retire|acreage|land|unitblock|house|villa|rural. Separated by comma for multiple options. Ex : townhouse,house,villa

optional_parameters.name: constructionStatus
optional_parameters.description: Ignore or one of the following : established|new

optional_parameters.name: pageSize
optional_parameters.description: The number of items returned per response. For paging purpose (max is 30)

An impressive name, an impressive apartment and an impressive price!

Was part of the hotel group but now for sale a large 2-bedroom 2-bathroom with car parking that comes with all of the furniture too.

With options a-plenty you can just buy and live in style with the hotel amenities at your fingertips, rent it out for a high rental yield or perhaps you can try your hand on short stays or Airbnb in a truly exceptional central location on St Kilda Road with transport at the door and lifestyle delights including Albert Park Lake, St Kilda and Fitzroy Street, Prahran/Windsor shopping and restaurants across the way and the beauty of Melbourne’s central city district just 13 minutes away on tram No.34
results.title: BANG - asking $470,000 ! Park Regis

results.description:
Perfectly positioned in the highly sought after “AURA" Apartment Complex, this generously sized single-bedroom apartment embraces a vibrant city lifestyle of elegance & class. Enjoy uninterrupted views over the Yarra River & Southbank promenade from this stunning location. A truly fantastic opportunity for first home buyers and savvy investors alike.

Offering a convenient & spacious layout, the light-filled apartment comprises an open plan & light filled living-dining area with floor to ceiling windows. Featuring a king-sized bedroom with mirrored built in robes & ample storage, ultra-spacious alfresco balcony offering uninterrupted city views across the Yarra River, a well appointed kitchen featuring glass splash-back, caesar-stone bench tops & stainless steel appliances. Also featuring a sparkling central bathroom & Euro laundry facilities. Other facilities include 24-7 Concierge, Secure intercom entry, TV-monitored security, Lift access and fully equipped-gymnasium.

Conveniently located amidst all that the CBD has to offer, in close proximity to Melbourne's iconic Crown Entertainment Complex filled with world-class restaurants, buzzing bars & top end fashionable boutiques, DFO shopping Centre, riverside restaurants and South Wharf bars. With trams at your doorstep, Flinders and Southern Cross Stations both a short walk away, this is luxury living at its best in the vibrant city lifestyle.

To arrange a private inspection please contact Annamaria on 0481 602 108
results.title: Sensational Single Bedroom in the Sought After 'Aura' Complex

results.description:
Transformed from the old Bulla factory into the MILQ Apartments, distinguished by exceptionally high standards this elegant two-bedroom, 67sqm apartment embodies an inspired contemporary living near the city's heart.

All within walking distance to both the University of Melbourne and the Royal Melbourne Hospital.

The subtle colour palette draws upon simple materials, alluring textures and classic colour fusions to create unique apartments interior, specially conceived to reflect the individuality of MILQs discerning residents.

To complement the quality finishes, European kitchen provide inspiration through crafted stone benchtop, quality appliances, ample storage and fully-tiled bathroom which share the kitchens modern textural elements. Timbered textures and mineral tones afford a warmth of character from the flooring underfoot to the light fittings above.

Offering a north facing balcony with amazing views, open plan kitchen, living and dining and a refined style and exceptional natural light.
New York-style car parking, extra storage and additional bike racks in the secured underground car parking area.

With an abundance of transport options and, situated within university high zone this apartment ticks all the boxes.
results.title: MILQ Apartments

results.description:
A seamless mix of vast space, northeastern sunlight and stunning city views, this impeccable 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment offers spectacular lifestyle appeal in a central Southbank setting. Take an easy stroll to South Melbourne Market, Crown, Boyd Community Hub and riverside restaurants with a boutique Woolworths supermarket on your doorstep.

Spacious open-plan living and dining is wonderfully underscored by a high-quality kitchen boasting a mirrored splashback, sleek stone surfaces, a waterfall-edged breakfast bar and the full complement of premium Miele appliances including a full-sized dishwasher. Superbly positioned 30 floors sky high in the designer Mainpoint building, an undercover balcony attracts the all-day warmth of northern and eastern sunlight, coming alive with breathtaking views sweeping across the city skyline. This apartment will be perfect for entertaining! Substantial in size, both light-filled bedrooms are graced with mirrored built-in robes and serviced by a pristine pair of luxe bathrooms with fully tiled shower areas and stone finishes.

Freshly painted with new floorboards, additional features include secure undercover parking, a storage cage, laundry capacity with a combination washing machine/dryer, an inviting hallway entrance, split-system heating/cooling, double glazing and slimline Venetian blinds plus roller blinds in the main bedroom. Mainpoint comes complete with intercom entry, high-speed lifts, a plush foyer, a 6-star energy-efficiency rating, 24-hour concierge and exclusive access to a heated pool and a fully equipped gym. Inspect with certainty!

* Photo identification will be required upon entering the property. Please contact our agent for your personal tour of this home today.
results.title: Northeast-Facing Showcase of Luxury, Location and Stunning City Views

results.description:
Awaken your senses to a new landmark Melbourne address. A unique residential offering behind the historic walls of Collingwood's acclaimed Yorkshire Brewery.

In contrast to the historic nineteenth century brew tower, The Yorkshire showcases clean lines and an elegant, contemporary design.

Strategically located right in the centre of Collingwood, this double storey unit is only three kilometers North-East of Melbourne CBD. Surrounded by fantastic bars and restaurants, the Smith Street shopping strip, public transport at your door step and much more. It is truly a must-live destination!

This property features:
--- Upstairs, it has 3 bedrooms with built-in-robes; Central bathroom comprising shower and toilet. Master bedroom with ensuite. A study area is also serviced upstairs.
--- On ground floor, spacious living area, plus open plan Kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances - European laundry - Reverse cycle heating and cooling system

A car stacker parking space (induction required) is also included in this townhouse.

You will not find a better value for such prestige condition, convenient location & generous size.
results.title: UNBELIEVABLE VALUE & MORE

agency.name: Jalin Realty Australia Pty Ltd - Melbourne

results.description:
Inspections strictly by appointment only - Contact Jay on 0499 688 988

Situated on one of the most prestigious addresses in the country, Collins Street, this vast loft-style penthouse is the true jewel in the crown with unencumbered views of iconic Melbourne landmarks such as the City Skyline, the Royal Botanical Gardens, the MCG, Yarra River and Port Phillip Bay

Boasting 260m2 of luxury living across two levels, the penthouse features Royal Oak Herringbone flooring that spans throughout the kitchen and living spaces – a pattern that resonates with the external facade tower design and continues through the tiling in the bathrooms. The penthouse kitchen is an entertainer’s dream, featuring high end European appliances and butler’s kitchen, elegant Italian stone, walnut timber veneer and fine copper detailing. Securing car-parking for two vehicles completes this truly unique offering

Crafted by globally recognized architects Bates Smart, the interior design has been conceived to create the ultimate urban living experience with elegant lines and intricate attention to detail. A clearly zoned layout with formal lounge and dining at the lower level, causal retreat with study at the upper level, and a dedicated powder room on each level for added convenience. Further features include three spacious bedrooms with ensuite, of which the master bedroom is complete with a full-size walk-in robe and stone bathtub.

Residents will also have access to the opulent St. James Club on Level 27, providing access to a private dining room and lounge, state-of-the-art gym, and theatre, while Collins Terrace – located on level three – allows residents to enjoy tranquil afternoons and evenings entertaining guests from the sumptuous open-air lounge and bar, or cooking up a storm in the gourmet chef’s kitchen.
results.title: A Glass Penthouse Amongst The Clouds

results.description:
This design-driven one bedroom with study nook in the tightly held Australis building sensationally delivers low-maintenance living with high-impact results! Offering extensive owner-occupier and investor appeal, head downstairs and discover the best of Melbourne’s iconic laneway culture in the heart of the city, moments from free city trams, Queen Victoria Market, Flagstaff Gardens, Southern Cross Station and the university precinct.

Set high on the 22nd floor, embrace stylish living from the very first step inside! Finished to the highest standards, enjoy an open and generous living space adjoining a corner, stone-topped Miele kitchen showcasing soft-closing cabinetry, and a Fisher and Paykel dishwasher drawer. Framed by floor-to-ceiling glass, sunlit spaces give way to a roomy undercover balcony showcasing sweeping vistas across the spectacular neighbourhood skyline. Enjoy total comfort in the ample bedroom with built-in robes, serviced by fully tiled bathroom boasting oversized walk-in shower.

Take full advantage of a concealed laundry, ducted heating and cooling, clever study/dining area, and keyless security building access. Australis is also the complete lifestyle address with 7-day concierge, barbeque areas, heated indoor pool and fully equipped gym.

* Photo identification will be required upon entering the property. Please contact our agent for your personal tour of this home today.
results.title: Designer Space + Study + Luxury Building!

results.description: Quality finishes and amenity highlight the enormous appeal of this immaculate one bedroom apartment occupying a prime position in the premium Reflections residential building. Optimising a well-scaled living domain extends to a private, covered balcony where you can enjoy the view as you wine and dine alfresco. Sleek modern kitchen, with stone finishes, Miele appliances & dishwasher. Plus, sparkling bathroom/rainfall shower, European laundry, split-system air conditioner, secure intercom/lift entry, car space and common alfresco entertainment zones. Opposite parks, North Melbourne Recreation Reserve and swimming pool, with zoning for University High and easy access to shops, cafés, transport and the CBD. Walking distance to Macaulay and North Melbourne train stations.
results.title: Premium Urban Living

results.description:
Situated in a wonderfully quiet and convenient Kensington neighbourhood, this distinctive double-storey townhouse delivers a brilliant low-maintenance lifestyle with its adaptable design, secure surrounds and abundance of natural light throughout.

Beyond the bold rendered facade emphasizing its industrial origins, the home's free-flowing interior showcases two generous bedrooms (larger master) with built-in robes both complemented by a contemporary bathroom with shower/tub combo. Flanked by floor-to-ceiling windows, the adaptable open-plan living/dining areas are serviced by a granite-bench kitchen with tiled splashbacks and stainless-steel cooking appliances. Other fine features of this trendy townhouse include split-system heating/cooling, solid hardwood floors and high ceilings throughout, as well as a European laundry with trough. Completing the picture is a balcony (from the living area) with northerly outlook and fully-decked central atrium, plus a private front courtyard with secure off-street parking via remote-control gate.

Walking distance to Kensington Village shops and cafes, Racecourse Road trams and both Kensington and Macaulay train stations, it's also close to the Moonee Ponds Creek Trail, local schools and kinder/childcare facilities, as well as easy access to Citylink.
results.title: Flair and Flexibility in a Perfect Position

results.description:
Perfectly positioned in a convenient cosmopolitan location between the Royal Botanic Gardens and Albert Park and surrounded by parklands, this first floor executive residence offers a floor plan of generous proportions and exceptional amenities.

Comprising of high ceilings throughout, the living and dining area is open plan and offers exceptional space opening onto an undercover outdoor terrace, ideal for all year entertaining.

The granite kitchen showcases updated European stainless steel appliances and offers an abundance of cupboard and bench space, three well-proportioned bedrooms, main with ensuite and walk-in robe, the other two serviced by central bathroom. A powder room, separate laundry, heating and cooling, security intercom and basement parking complete this exceptional inner city residence.

The highly regarded "Domain" is a high security building and residents' facilities include 24 hour Concierge, Residents' Lounge and sun terrace, Business Centre and boardroom, luxuriously refurbished indoor pool, large well equipped gym, sauna and steam room. Perfectly located within close proximity to Melbourne's best private schools, shops, transport and the CBD.
results.title: The Domain – Brilliantly Positioned Opposite the Royal Botanic Gardens

results.description:
Inner City Living at its finest with close proximity to Yarra parklands, schools, cafes and station. Ideally suited for both owner occupiers or astute investors this well designed, luxury appointed residence offers low-maintenance living, sophisticated styling and flexible floorplan all in a Blue Chip Location.

Set over three light-filled levels this city-fringe town residence comprises 3 double bedrooms each with their own bathrooms, generous and expansive living and dining areas flowing through to two private balconies; bespoke central kitchen includes Miele appliances, stone benchtops, along with plenty of storage. Including a large internal-entry garage, this elegant home features polished bamboo floors, custom storage, split-system air conditioning and solar HWS.

The property provides a secure tenant for those looking for investment or flexibility to offer vacant possession for those looking at owner occupying.
results.title: Architectural Designed Modern Luxury

results.description:
*Sale by Set Negotiation - Offers close Tuesday, 18th July 2023 at 5pm*

Enjoying the peace of the 24th floor high above the hustle and bustle, this two-bedroom apartment in the renowned "Upper West Side" complex is a superb option for professionals, couples, downsizers and investors alike. Anchored by a stone finished, stainless steel equipped kitchen, the open plan living extends through stacking sliders to a balcony where you can entertain against a backdrop of the city lights. Make the most of a lifestyle location that has the tram, Southern Cross Station, Spencer Outlet Centre, Etihad Stadium, Docklands precinct, Crown Complex, Flagstaff Gardens and a great choice of cafes, restaurants and entertainment options at the front door.

* Occupant facilities include gym, rooftop garden, rock climbing wall and 25 m pool.
* Two bedrooms, main with picture window
* Perfect place to take in New Years Eve fireworks with friends
* Split system climate control for year-round comfort
* Sleek, stylish bathroom
* Concealed laundry
* Quality fittings fixtures and finishes throughout
* Secure intercom entry

results.title: Live The Ultimate Inner-City Lifestyle

results.description:
Perfectly located in the prestigious North Melbourne postcode, this two-bedroom apartment literally tops the lot with its sumptuous proportions. Approx. 2.5km from the Melbourne CBD, The Queen Victoria Market and centrally located with close proximity to parks, recreation facilities, world-class medical and educational institutions and easy access to public transport.

Lustrous sophistication, deluxe finishes and designer spaces showcase this two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment in Arden Gardens. Displaying sleek timber floorboards capture the abundance of natural light and poise the open plan living and dining area which seamlessly flows out to a superb balcony capturing city views, perfect for the entertainer.

Showcasing a state-of-the-art kitchen with natural stone marbled splash back and waterfall stone island/breakfast bar and complemented by Miele appliances throughout, with gas stove, electric oven (900mm) and a meticulously built-in fridge and dishwasher.
Additional highlights include a stunning master bedroom with ensuite. an equally stylish family bathroom, laundry, split system a/c, excellent storage throughout, secure video intercom entry, fob lift access and a secure car parking space with an additional storage cage.

Exclusive access to common areas such as a separate rooftop, a private function room providing ample indoor and outdoor space, gym, 2 separate cinema rooms, and direct lift access to Woolworths. Surrounded by green spaces, sports grounds, local pool, Melrose/Errol Street shops/cafes, transport options, Queen Victoria Market and within University High and North Melbourne Primary School catchment zones.


A rare find where an inspection will be worthy.
results.title: Luxury at its finest - City Skyline

address.streetAddress: Shop 40, Stable Shopping Centre, Childs Rd

results.description:
Experience the ultimate waterfront lifestyle at 103 Beach St - a prestigious address in Port Melbourne that promises to redefine luxury living. This iconic landmark, brought to life by Luxcon in collaboration with the acclaimed Carr Design, celebrates the unique beauty of its location with its dramatic scalloped facades reminiscent of ocean waves and ripples in the sand.

With its prime position by the port and beaches of Port Phillip Bay, 103 Beach St is one of the first buildings that catch the eye of cruise ship passengers as they arrive at Station Pier.

Inside, Coco Republic has designed the interiors to offer contemporary elegance and sophisticated calm, with fine craftsmanship and world-class amenities.

The attention to detail is second to none, with only the finest fittings and finishes, such as Astra Walker tapware and Swiss-made V-ZUG kitchen appliances. The apartments feature fresh whites, light greys, and honey accents, available in Salt or Smoke color schemes.

With Port Melbourne's exciting mix of gourmet experiences, inviting cafes, and bars, 103 Beach St offers an unparalleled lifestyle by the sea. Don't miss out on the opportunity to be a part of this iconic landmark that will elevate the urban and social fabric of Port Melbourne. Come and discover why time is often forgotten when you live by the sea.

For more information go to www.103beachst.com.au
results.title: Wake up to the Best Views in Melbourne

Located on the quiet end of Dorcas Street within walking distance to the lifestyle destinations of South Melbourne, South Yarra, Crown, Arts Precinct, Sports Precinct and Melbourne CBD - The Evermore offers unparalleled luxury living in one of the most sought after locations.

From the open-air heated pool, fully equipped gymnasium, dual sauna rooms, dedicated study workspace, resident dining rooms with full kitchen facilities, resident lounges, and your very own cinema — the amenities here are anything but common.

Gourmet kitchens feature custom natural marble as well as the latest in Miele appliances inc. semi-integrated dishwashers and generous storage solutions. Bathrooms are impressive with brass or chrome tapware, mirrored vanity units, fully tiled shower bases, concealed European laundries and plenty of space.

Engineered timber flooring graces the living areas and for the bedrooms, 100% woolen carpets create a warm and inviting space to rest.

Surrounded by an excellent array of transportation options with 4 tram stops minutes away and a new train station currently under construction it’s easy to see how The Evermore earned a transit score of 100/100 and a walk score of 97/100.

results.title: INNER CITY LIVING

results.description:
Loved and maintained by the one family for over 55 years this extremely comfortable brick terrace is sure to please given its cherished location upon one of Clifton Hill’s best streets. Only a stroll to the delights of Queens Parade, picturesque Darling Gardens, renowned schooling and multiple public transport options in addition to ease of access to the vibrant lifestyle precincts surrounding Smith/Johnson Streets… You’ll simply want for nothing in this envied & convenient residential pocket.
With a flexible floor plan currently configured as formal entry hall, 2 sizeable bedrooms, full width lounge (split system heating/cooling), updated kitchen with gas cooking/dishwasher, renovated bathroom and separate laundry with direct exit to low maintenance rear yard. Live in happily now whilst the property’s ample allotment of some 157sqm with rear pedestrian access may lead to the contemplation of future extension/renovation in the knowledge that this locale is simply sublime.
results.title: A home & location to be enjoyed…

results.description:
Lavishly proportioned and luxuriously finished with breathtaking panoramic views from the 17th floor, this magnificent residence within the renowned Lucient development is a statement in high-end St Kilda Road living. Extraordinary in scale, the impeccable interior spaces deliver the refinement and versatility for executive living with a faultless alfresco ambience, offering a desirable indoor-outdoor environment that is simply unmatched.

High ceilings flow from the elegant entrance hall to the expansive open-plan living/dining domain, where sweeping views take centre stage, encompassing the MCG, Rod Laver Arena and AAMI Stadium lights and distant mountain ranges before wrapping around to the glistening water of Port Phillip Bay.

A premium Italian-imported kitchen with a suite of Miele appliances, including dual ovens, a coffee machine, a dishwasher and six-burner gas stove, creates a stylish hub for entertaining with its solid granite benchtops whilst a gas fireplace in the living zone adds desirable warmth. Slide open the full-height doors to an exceptional full-width alfresco terrace, and relish the seamless transition to the breathtaking scenery through towering glass walls, forming the perfect backdrop for entertaining.

Three superbly sized bedrooms, each with private ensuites and custom robes, include the indulgent main suite with spa ensuite and walk-in robe, orientated to enjoy the rare viewpoint over Albert Park Golf Course, Albert Park Lake and the bay from its private terrace. Appointed with zoned heating and cooling, double glazing, architectural lighting, two secure parking spaces, storage cage, abundant integrated storage solutions, a powder room, large laundry, and exclusive use of Lucient's resort-style amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, a 25-metre pool, sauna, steam room, spa and gym.
results.title: Unparalleled Sky High Luxury Living

results.description:
An inviting expression of designer style, this well-presented 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom apartment offers city-edge luxury with unbeatable convenience. Everything you could possibly want or need is less than 10 minutes away on foot! Stroll to the CBD, Flinders Street trains, Crown, the Arts Precinct, Woolworths shopping and the crowd-pleasing collection of cafes, bars and restaurants lining the Yarra River. This is truly living!

Sensationally set on the 15th floor of the award-winning Southbank Grand building, roomy open-plan living and dining is complemented by a stone-topped kitchen featuring a breakfast bar and high-end appliances including an integrated microwave and a Fisher and Paykel dish-drawer. Step outside into the eastern sunlight and relax on your own undercover balcony boasting picturesque views sweeping over the neighbourhood skyline with a regal glimpse of Government House. This private perch is ideal for a morning coffee, expertly capturing morning sunlight. Both mirror-robed bedrooms are naturally lit and generously sized, while a fully tiled primary bathroom comes complete with laundry capability including a combination washer/dryer. The wide-reaching main bedroom is enhanced by a deluxe ensuite and a substantial study zone.

Additional features include secure parking, ducted heating and cooling, double glazing, recessed
down-lighting, and slimline Venetian blinds plus roller blinds in the front bedroom. Southbank Grand is graced with intercom entry, high-speed lifts, a plush foyer, concierge service and premium resort-style facilities including an indoor pool, BBQ terrace and a fully equipped gym. Embrace a rare opportunity to live the life of your dreams!

Masterfully created by architects Elenberg Fraser, this beautiful apartment will certainly impress with its focus on quality fittings and finishes, high square set ceilings and large windows for optimal daylight exposure throughout the open plan living and dining zone.

The adjoining kitchen showcases stone benchtops/splashbacks, Smeg appliances, integrated dishwasher plus concealed fridge and microwave, while the sunroom (enclosed balcony), provides a light-filled space to sit and unwind.

Configured to accommodate two bedrooms, each with mirrored built-in-robes and serviced by a bathroom with toilet plus a convenient European laundry.

Delivering year-round climate control, the residence benefits from ducted heating/air conditioning, while a video intercom entry and secure lift provide peace of mind.

Balancing luxury with leisure, this brilliant apartment comes with access to the exquisite resident facilities of a heated pool, sauna, steam room, gymnasium, library, lounge and outdoor terrace, while a winter garden, Cocktail bar and function room rest on level 46.

Or you could simply venture outside and wander to Clarendon Street cafes, Southbank Promenade, Crown Entertainment Complex, Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, the CBD and the fresh produce of South Melbourne Market. Near Botanic Gardens, Albert Park Lake, beaches, Queen Victoria Market, trains plus major arterials.

results.description:
Crafted by Rothelowman Architecture, this apartment brings a new calibre of design to the heart of Melbourne. Combining a sophisticated façade with a series of expertly curated living spaces, this flexible apartment has been designed to nurture a diverse range of lifestyles.

Whether you’re entertaining friends on weekends or cooking up a feast during the week, well-appointed kitchen makes any task effortless. Enjoy preparing food amongst beautiful finishes, complete with generous storage ensuring all your crockery, utensils and pantry items have a home.

Boasting generous proportions and abundant natural light, the open-plan living area couldn’t be more perfect for entertaining. Open the doors to your spacious terrace area to combine indoor and outdoor living.

As you walk into the bathroom you see how raw, natural finishes in subdued tones work together to create an overwhelming sense of calm – this soothing palette is combined with abundant storage that ensures there’s a place for all toiletries with room to spare.

The building has been designed to foster sustainable living, implemented with a range of eco-conscious design features; with an overall NatHERs rating of 6 stars, NBN is also available and connected. Providing rainwater tanks, efficient water fixtures, effective natural ventilation, low-emission finishes and numerous other sustainable inclusions, create an efficient living experience for its residents whilst reducing its impact on the world of tomorrow.

Occupying the upper levels of the renowned Collins Arch, this beautifully proportioned residence provides panoramic views across the Yarra River, Southbank skyline, sporting precinct and the bayside region that are spectacular by day and truly dramatic by night. Large Collins Street Residence with Exceptional Yarra River Views.

Apartment 2806 encompasses a three bedroom residence, providing approximately 135 sqm of open plan kitchen/dining/living area opening to a 15 sqm private terrace, master suite with walk-in robe and appointed ensuite, second bedroom with sizeable built-in robes, central bathroom and European laundry. The beautifully appointed kitchen with ambient natural stone, 2pac and timber veneer finishes, Miele appliances and stainless steel appointments blends seamlessly via oak timber flooring with the living areas, and extends to the outdoor terrace allowing you to combine the livable spaces and invite the dramatic ambience inside. The residence is complemented by 2 car spaces and 1 storage space.

This exceptional apartment is one of the most premium three bedroom residences within the city, representing an incredibly scarce opportunity within the prized component of one of Melbourne's most iconic and renowned buildings.

The Building

Collins Arch is an architectural masterpiece, the significance and calibre of which are unlikely to the replicated within the Melbourne CBD. Residents of this remarkable building enjoy access to exceptional facilities including a day-time concierge, 25m swimming pool, yoga room, private dining rooms and kitchen, lounge and terrace entertaining areas, together with a three-level vertical sky-garden with adjoining terrace capturing sweeping views across the city.

The Precinct

Collins Arch occupies an entire island site with primary frontage to renowned Collins Street. This exceptional precinct is one of the most select residential locations within Melbourne's CBD, within immediate proximity to arguably Australia's most renowned culinary precincts, major finance and commerce houses, luxury retail, entertainment, high-end bars and exceptional public transport and connectivity to the balance of the CBD and the Southbank arts and entertainment precinct. It is in all respects a quintessential premium city location.

Serene parkland surrounds, city views and a prestigious inner-city lifestyle are just the beginning with this opulently finished two bedroom two bathroom apartment, part of the landmark “Arcadia”' building, designed by renowned Fender Katsalidis Architects.
Ideal for professionals and investors this designer apartment features an expansive and luxuriously fitted open living area where plush carpets and a granite topped designer kitchen form an opulent backdrop to the city and parkland views.
The sunlit balcony providing an outdoor space from which to enjoy this impressive setting. The stylish blend of luxury and comfort continues through two double bedrooms with built-in robes, one with balcony access, and two bathrooms featuring travertine finishes, frameless showers and a decadent tub, the master bedroom with ensuite, a separate laundry, abundant storage, secure video entry, heating and cooling, lift access plus a secure car space and two storage cages. Surrounded by Royal and Princes Parks, the Zoo, vibrant Sydney Road and Lygon Street cafes and restaurants, Princess Hill Secondary College, and a short tram trip to the university/hospital precincts and the CBD, it presents a prestigious low-maintenance lifestyle in the heart of Melbourne’s leafy inner city.

Features:
- Luxury Fender Katsalidis designed two bedroom apartment, part of the Arcadia tower
- Opulent open plan spills to a balcony with city and parkland views

- Stylish granite topped gourmet kitchen

- Bedrooms with BIR’s are completed by two luxe bathrooms, master with ensuite
- Modern amenities include heating/cooling, secure video entry, lift access, car space and two storage cages
- Prestige locale bordered by Princes Park, Zoo, university/hospital precincts and CBD

results.description:
Spectacular city views, magnificent proportions and sublime finishes underscore the luxury, sophistication and exclusivity of this half floor sub-penthouse in one of Melbourne's most coveted and prestigious addresses.
Designed by world-renowned architects, Bates Smart, this three bedroom, three bathroom plus powder room residence on Level 54 of "Collins House" features parquetry floors, bespoke timber cabinetry and marble and stone finishes. Floor-to -ceiling windows frame magnificent views of the Yarra River, iconic sporting venues, the Dandenong's and scenic northern ranges.
Providing an ideal setting for entertaining with ease and offering everyday enjoyment, the marble and Miele kitchen boasts two ovens, dishwasher, gas cooktop, integrated fridge/freezer, and butler's pantry with coffee machine, second dishwasher and ample cupboards. Your dinner guests will be dazzled by the panoramic views while the adjacent living room with electric fireplace offers more sensational vistas. Nearby, the large home office with bespoke cabinetry reflects today's "work from home" environment.
Zoned in a private wing, the main suite includes a walk-in wardrobe and sublime ensuite, while two additional robed bedrooms, one with an ensuite and one near the central bathroom are grouped together. A dedicated laundry, central ducted heating and cooling, abundant storage, designer tapware, motorized blinds and secure parking for two cars are more highlights of this stunning residence.
Includes a large outdoor BBQ area, Gold Class Media Room, Sports Bar, two lounges and dining room, private gym and 24-hour concierge. Walk to trams, Southern Cross and Flinders Street Stations, while taking advantage of Collins House's proximity to the city Centre, Marvel Stadium, Fed Square, Flagstaff Gardens and the Arts Precinct.
